claim.statement: GitHub's current environment guide says Copilot cloud agent can run on self-hosted GitHub Actions runners, recommends ephemeral single-use runners, limits compatibility to Ubuntu x64 or Windows 64-bit, and requires the integrated firewall to be disabled because it is incompatible with self-hosted runners.

source.title: Configure the development environment
source.locator: Using self-hosted GitHub Actions runners; compatibility note and step 2

limitations: The guide recommends single-use runners but does not establish that every self-hosted deployment follows the recommendation.
The catalog did not inspect a self-hosted runner, network control or task.
unknowns: The runner owner, lifecycle, image, persistence, network segmentation and access to internal resources are unknown.
The external firewall or other network controls used after disabling the integrated firewall are unknown.

relationships.note: Self-hosted execution is a named alternative to the GitHub-hosted environment and must retain its different infrastructure boundary.
